title: Worker scheduling enforcement in placement services
observed_behavior_before: Generic WorkerPolicyService filtered only liveness-online workers and policy constraints; operator SchedulingState did not prevent new placements.
MLPlacementService filtered only liveness-online workers and ML compatibility constraints; operator SchedulingState did not prevent new inference placements.
intended_behavior: Only workers with active scheduling state are eligible for new generic worker placements.
Only workers with active scheduling state are eligible for new ML inference placements.
Cordoned, draining, maintenance, disabled, and unknown scheduling states are rejected with operator-visible reasons.
Ranking/preview outputs retain rejected workers with reasons so UI/read-model projections can explain placement decisions.
out_of_scope: Controlplane command kinds, publishers, reactor handlers, or projections
